title: The Aurora Dynamics payroll incident
briefing: Someone at Aurora Dynamics gave away their single sign-on password last week. Overnight an attacker used it, added a hidden mailbox rule and tried to redirect a payroll run. Finance has handed you the mailbox and the security logs. Several of these messages are suspicious. Only one of them caused the compromise.

emails.subject: Ops standup notes - week 38
emails.bodyText: Morning all. Notes from the standup are in the shared drive. Two carriers are still pending confirmation for the October run. Shout if you need anything before Thursday.

emails.subject: Friday lunch order - reply by Wednesday
emails.bodyText: Collecting the Friday lunch order again. Reply with your choice and any allergies by Wednesday evening and I will place it in one go.

emails.subject: Congratulations! Your colleague reward is waiting
emails.bodyText: You have been selected for an employee appreciation gift card worth 500 dollars. Claim within 24 hours or the reward passes to another employee. No purchase necessary.

emails.subject: Q3 supplier statement for your records
emails.bodyText: Hi Rachel, attaching the quarterly statement as usual. Nothing outstanding on our side. Let me know if the reference numbers do not line up with your ledger.

emails.subject: Invoice AD-4471 - updated payment details
emails.bodyText: Please note our remittance account has changed for this quarter. Kindly direct payment of invoice AD-4471 to the updated details below and confirm receipt of this notice.

emails.subject: Fire drill this Thursday at 10am
emails.bodyText: A scheduled fire drill takes place on Thursday at 10am. Please use the north stairwell and assemble at the loading bay. Wardens will sweep each floor.

emails.subject: Outstanding parking charge - final notice
emails.bodyText: Our records show an unpaid charge for vehicle bay 14 dated 2 September. Settle within 48 hours to avoid escalation and an administration fee.

emails.subject: Re: payroll cutoff dates for October
emails.bodyText: Confirming the cutoff is the 22nd this month because of the public holiday. Any adjustments after that date move to the following cycle.

emails.subject: Your expense claim EX-20881 was approved
emails.bodyText: Claim EX-20881 has been approved and will be paid with the next cycle. No further action is needed from you.

emails.subject: Wi-Fi maintenance on Saturday morning
emails.bodyText: Wireless access on floors three and four will be unavailable on Saturday between 7am and 9am while we replace two access points. Wired connections are unaffected.

emails.subject: Action required: re-verify your SSO access today
emails.bodyText: Our directory migration finishes this evening. Accounts that have not been re-verified will lose single sign-on access tomorrow morning, including payroll and expenses. Re-verify with your usual work password using the secure link below. This takes under a minute.

emails.subject: Team photo next Tuesday
emails.bodyText: We are refreshing the intranet team photos next Tuesday afternoon. Slots are fifteen minutes each and the sign-up sheet is on the noticeboard.

emails.subject: Updated travel policy takes effect 1 October
emails.bodyText: The revised travel policy raises the domestic daily allowance and asks for receipts on anything above fifty dollars. The summary is on the intranet policy page.

emails.subject: Your work password expires in 7 days
emails.bodyText: Your password expires in seven days. Change it from the lock screen on your own laptop, or press Ctrl Alt Delete and choose Change Password. The service desk will never ask you for your password.

emails.subject: Re: carrier rate review - numbers for Friday
emails.bodyText: Rachel, here are the revised carrier numbers for Friday's review. The second tab has the comparison against last quarter. No rush before Thursday.

emails.subject: Canteen menu for week 39
emails.bodyText: Next week's canteen menu is attached to the noticeboard and on the intranet. Vegetarian options are available every day at the hot counter.

emails.subject: Urgent: your mailbox quota is full
emails.bodyText: Your mailbox has reached its storage limit and incoming messages are being rejected. Verify your account now to restore delivery and release the queued messages.

emails.subject: Your annual security training is due
emails.bodyText: Your annual security training module is due by the end of the month. It takes about twenty minutes and is available from the learning tile on the intranet home page.

emails.subject: Benefits enrolment closes tonight
emails.bodyText: Enrolment for the new benefits year closes at midnight. Confirm your selections now or your current cover will lapse and cannot be reinstated until next year.

emails.subject: Notes from our call this morning
emails.bodyText: Good speaking earlier. To confirm, the delivery window moves to the first week of October and the pricing stays as agreed. I will send the revised schedule once it is signed off.

timeline.label: Web proxy - link opened
timeline.detail: k.lim opened aurora-parking-notice.example/fine. No credential submission followed and the host appears in no later event.

timeline.label: Data loss prevention - credential pattern
timeline.detail: A credential-shaped form submission left r.tan's workstation for aurora-dynarnics-sso.example.

timeline.label: Identity provider - successful sign-in
timeline.detail: Single sign-on succeeded for r.tan from an unfamiliar network and an unrecognised device.

timeline.label: Mailbox - hidden rule created
timeline.detail: A rule was added to r.tan's mailbox forwarding any message containing the word invoice to an external address, then marking it read.

timeline.label: Payroll - bank change submitted
timeline.detail: A payroll bank detail change was submitted from r.tan's account and held by the approval queue.

timeline.label: Web proxy - request blocked
timeline.detail: s.menon's request to hr-benefits-portal.example was blocked by the web filter before any page loaded.

evidenceOptions.label: The sending domain is a lookalike of the company domain, replacing the letter m with the pair r-n
The proxy recorded that message's destination host being opened, and a credential submission to the same host one minute later
The message pressures the reader with a same-day deadline
A later request to the benefits host was blocked by the web filter
The message arrived after the unfamiliar single sign-on at 03:14
The message carried a macro-enabled attachment
